question: India's first exclusive private jet terminal was inaugurated on 17 September 2020 in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Delhi.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Civil Aviation Minister **Hardeep Singh Puri __**has inaugurated India's first General Aviation Terminal at Delhi airport.
 
• The exclusive terminal will handle the flight operations of private jets.
 
• The new terminal has been built to support the movement and processing of passengers flying through chartered flights from IGI Airport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Airport Authority of India (AAI)

__
 
• It is a statutory authority.
 
• It was founded on 1st April 1965.
 
• It works under the Ministry of Civil Aviation, Government of India.
 
• It is responsible for creating, upgrading, maintaining, and managing civil aviation infrastructure in India.
 
• Headquarters - New Delhi.
 
• Chairman -**Sanjeev Kumar(as of oct-2022).​**
